getInstance = computeIfAbsent over the final map from the final supplier: an instance, once made, is always the answer
declared methods: the attributes map is written only by getInstance's computeIfAbsent (assignAllValues / assignBaseValues / load go through getInstance and the instance's own methods)
setDirty: dirty = true, onDirty.accept(this) (the read our counter hook answers)
getValue: recompute only while dirty, else the cached value
setBaseValue: setDirty on a change NeoForge 21.1.252 production variant: instruction/control-flow equivalence verified; only compiler layout, local slots and named synthetic capture fields differ.

addOrUpdateTransientModifier: setDirty whenever the held object changes NeoForge 21.1.252 production variant: instruction/control-flow equivalence verified; only compiler layout, local slots and named synthetic capture fields differ.
removeModifier(id): setDirty when it removed one
load: setDirty NeoForge 21.1.252 production variant: instruction/control-flow equivalence verified; only compiler layout, local slots and named synthetic capture fields differ.
getModifier: a read of the id map

declared methods: every change of the base value or of the held modifiers goes through setDirty in the same call (setBaseValue, addModifier, addOrUpdateTransientModifier, removeModifier, replaceFrom, load and the methods built on them)

legendary_spellbooks_annihilation_bonus_.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapMethod on AnnihilationAttributeBonusEvent.onLivingTick (EntityTickEvent.Post on NeoForge): a non-living entity runs the original; after the handler's own tick-parity and client test, a run is skipped when the entity's memo (LsLivingMemoMixin field) says the annihilation instance was absent last time, or the annihilation instance saw no setDirty, the fire and ender instances saw no setDirty and are not dirty, and the last run ended with the bonus modifier at a number; else the original runs and is recorded (the three getAttribute(Holder) calls wrapped by @WrapOperation keep the instances unchanged). Counter: LsAttributeVersionMixin (@ModifyExpressionValue on setDirty's onDirty read; dirty flag through @Shadow). Legendary Spellbooks 0.3.2 reads no config factors (0.4.1 did), so the memo keeps none. Runtime flag legendarySpellbooksAnnihilationBonusMemo, shadow legendarySpellbooksAnnihilationBonusMemo.shadow. Helper bons.furious.patch.legendaryspellbooks_coo49.LsAnnihilationMemo.
